title: In 1977, a radio telescope in Ohio called Big Ear picked up a 72-second signal so strong and so cleanly from the direction of Sagittarius that the astronomer on duty circled it in red ink and wrote ‘Wow!’ in the margin, and nearly fifty years later nobody has ever heard it again.
